title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa essentials: an update on investigation of essential genes
strain_evidence: Review. Discusses P. aeruginosa strain PAO1 annotation, MPAO1 (Lee et al.) grown on six media incl. CF sputum, and PA14 (Liberati et al. mariner MAR2xT7).
notes: Background/introduction only. Use to locate primary datasets; do not extract labels from the review itself.

title: Essential genome of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in cystic fibrosis sputum
strain_evidence: Uses BOTH strains: 'Wild-type PAO1 and individual transposon mutants with growth defects in SCFM2'; 'only two genes were significantly less fit in SCFM2 than in MOPS-sputum in both PAO1 and PA14'. PAO1 mutant fitness reported directly.
notes: CORRECTION: previously classified PA14-only; paper contains DIRECT PAO1 fitness data (Tier3). Supplement download blocked (B-NET/B-LIT-01).

title: General and condition-specific essential functions of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
strain_evidence: 'The P. aeruginosa parent strain was MPAO1'; transposon mutagenesis via E. coli SM10 lambda-pir/pIT2 (Manoil-lab two-allele/ISlacZ system). Comparison table lists this study strain as PAO1.
notes: MAJOR CORRECTION: previously classified PA14; paper strain is MPAO1 (a PAO1 derivative). Directly usable for PAO1 model validation once supplement obtained (B-NET/B-LIT-01).

title: Defining the core essential genome of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
strain_evidence: 'Previous transposon mutagenesis studies of two common laboratory strains, PA14 and PAO1...'; determines core essential genome (~321 genes) across all strains analyzed. PAO1 is one of the analyzed strains.
supplementary_available: yes (PNAS supp + Broad fitness portal data.broadinstitute.org/fitness/; not yet downloaded)
pao1_usable_directly: partial (PAO1 per-strain list if separable in supp; unverified)
notes: Multi-strain core-essential source (also Tier5 background). PAO1 per-strain essential list must be confirmed in the supplement before use.

title: Identification of fitness determinants during energy-limited growth arrest in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
strain_evidence: 'We grew cultures of the PA14 wild-type (WT) strain aerobically... in minimal medium with 40 mM pyruvate'; reads 'mapped to the UCBPP-PA14 genome sequence' via ARTIST pipeline.
method: Tn-seq (energy-limited growth arrest; pyruvate-C or O2 limitation)
notes: Confirmed PA14. Growth-ARREST survival determinant != growth essentiality; keep phenotype class distinct. Erratum 10.1128/mbio.00576-18.

title: Surviving the host: microbial metabolic genes required for growth of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in physiologically-relevant conditions
strain_evidence: 'we used a saturated transposon insertion mutant pool of P. aeruginosa strain PAO1 and transposon insertion sequencing (Tn-Seq), to identify genes conditionally important for survival'. SCFM among conditions.
notes: CORRECTION: strain was 'confirm'; paper explicitly uses PAO1. Directly usable for PAO1 model validation (metabolic host-condition fitness) once supplement obtained. Hancock lab, published 2022-11-25.
